dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How does a person become as rich, or as rich, or as super rich as Lady Ningguang?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that the only impression she gives you? Riches?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, there's the huge Jade Chamber, too! But isn't that also made of Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, you need an excellent mind...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's really good at giving people nicknames!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You need to be very familiar with the workings of the markets...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A serving of Fisherman's Toast goes for 1025 Mora, and no discounts even on rainy days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... how do you make friends with a really rich person?
